name: git-repo-auth-mcp
description: Worker-minted, short-lived, scoped GitHub App installation tokens over MCP. Currently GitHub; forge-agnostic by design.

scripts.deploy:staging: node scripts/validate-deployment.mjs staging account/wrangler.staging.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config account/wrangler.staging.jsonc --experimental-autoconfig=false
scripts.deploy:production: node scripts/validate-deployment.mjs production wrangler.jsonc && node scripts/build-info.mjs && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --experimental-autoconfig=false && node scripts/provision-service-key.mjs
